content: IBus component registration: XML in /usr/share/ibus/component/ (root) or via IBUS_COMPONENT_PATH env; ibus-daemon caches a registry in ~/.cache/ibus/bus/ that is timestamp-invalidated and frequently stale - new engines often need 'ibus write-cache' (+ optionally --system) then 'ibus restart', sometimes logout/login for GNOME Settings to show them (mozc #500, silverblue#9, Guix#22707, desktopi18n ibus tips). exec path in component XML must exist and be absolute. ibus list-engine verifies registration.
